scripts.dev: npx supabase start & cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.db:reset: supabase db reset && npm run db:dump && npm run gen:types
scripts.db:push: supabase db push && supabase db dump --linked -f supabase/schema.sql && node scripts/split-schema.mjs
scripts.db:dump: supabase db dump --local -f supabase/schema.sql && node scripts/split-schema.mjs
